gdp_vintage: SCI provincial accounts 2016 × World Bank GDP 2016

yields.label: Food
yields.description: Cropland area in square kilometres: the cropland share of each hex in ESA WorldCover 2021 (10 m satellite land cover) times the hex's area, summed over the area's hexes.

yields.label: Production
yields.description: Power-plant capacity in megawatts located in the area (WRI Global Power Plant Database, last updated 2021). A stand-in for industrial capacity; nuclear plants are left out of this map.

yields.label: Gold
yields.description: Gross domestic product per year in current US dollars, 2016. Each province's share of GDP in the Statistical Centre of Iran's provincial accounts (1395, 2016/17) times the World Bank's national GDP for 2016. County and city GDP is an estimate: the province's GDP split by population share.

yields.label: Science
yields.description: Universities with a Wikipedia article in at least 8 languages (Wikidata), counted where their main campus is. A rough signal of research prominence, not a measure of output.

yields.label: Culture
yields.description: UNESCO World Heritage properties (Wikidata), counted where they are. Parts of one property inscribed the same year and within 40 km of each other count once.
